title: The Sitter: Honeymoon
description:
Things have been shaky in your marriage, to say the least. After months of sleeping alone in bed with no sex, your wife has decided to take the rest of the family away for a little while to clear her head.

You just got home from dropping your wife and brats off at the airport for a long visit to your in-laws. Finally, you and the sitter will be alone for a whole week! You’ve been such a good boy for her, locked up in chastity, and being at her beck and call. A part of you still secretly hopes that once you are unlocked, she will use your cock. At the very least, you expect you’ll be let out of chastity and allowed to service her orally…

… you’ve been such a good boy, there’s no way she won’t at least give you that, right?

The Sitter wants to play house, too. But she has other ideas.
author: Goddess Nichole
